Thank you.}} ==Guide== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="6" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !Notes |- |[[File:Key With Tape icon.png|link=Health Resort office key with a blue tape]] |[[Health Resort office key with a blue tape]] |1 |Required |Unlocks room 110 of the East wing in the Health Resort on [[Shoreline]]. |} In this quest you have to find [[Sanitar]]'s office, which is located in the health resort on [[Shoreline]]. After you unlocked the door, simply walk into the room to complete the objective. After you completed the objective, you have to extract from [[Shoreline]].
